title: Deposit Pre-Order Deposits and Marlowe Rewards Tier Status
content:
Deposits a member has placed on a Deposit Pre-Order under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders add a deposit credit to their Marlowe Rewards tier-qualifying spend.

## The deposit credit

The deposits concerned are those captured in the 12 months ending on the handling date on the member's Deposit Pre-Order. How much of them counts depends on the reservation's status.

| Status of that Deposit Pre-Order | Deposit credit |
|---|---|
| in production or allocated | the deposits captured in the 12 months, in full |
| reserved or awaiting consent | half (50 percent) of those deposits |
| any other status, such as fulfilled or cancelled | nothing |

The deposit credit is a dollar amount added to the tier-qualifying spend.

## Illustration (hypothetical deposits of 400.00 captured in the 12 months)

| Reservation status | Deposit credit |
|---|---|
| in production | 400.00 |
| allocated | 400.00 |
| awaiting consent | 200.00 |
| reserved | 200.00 |
| cancelled | 0.00 |

A deposit captured more than 12 months before the handling date does not count, whatever the status of the reservation.
